  • It isn't "diamond encased", rather the diamond is the battery itself.

  • It doesn't produce much power, e.g. one wouldn't run refrigerator of any size.

  • When not under load it produces heat rather than electricity.

  • It works, IIRC, by beta-decay, so the radioactivity isn't very dangerous.

Mind you this doesn't mean it's useless as there are many devices which require small, continuous amounts of energy which this sort of technology can improve: you buy the device, battery built in, and it runs longer than you do.
